en: 2 Kings 25

p.src: 1  In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it around it.

ja: ネブカドネザルが、彼とその
勢とともにエルサレムに対して
いた。そして彼らはその
en: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it around it.
u.src: 1  In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it around it.

p.src: 2  So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

en: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
u.src: 2  So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

p.src: 3  On the ninth day of the fourth month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

ja: のためのパンがなくなった。
en: On the ninth day of the fourth month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
u.src: 3  On the ninth day of the fourth month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

p.src: 4  Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden (now the Chaldeans were against the city around it); and the king went by the way of the Arabah.

ja: はアラバへの道を進んだ。
en: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden (now the Chaldeans were against the city around it); and the king went by the way of the Arabah.

p.src: 5  But the Chaldean army pursued the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

en: But the Chaldean army pursued the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
u.src: 5  But the Chaldean army pursued the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

れて上った。そして彼らは彼にさばきを
en: Then they captured the king and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they passed judgment on him.
u.src: 6  Then they captured the king and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they passed judgment on him.

p.src: 7  They killed Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes, then put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

en: They killed Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes, then put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

p.src: 8  Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

en: Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
u.src: 8  Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

p.src: 9  He burned the LORD’s house, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem. He burned every great house with fire.

ja: き、エルサレムのすべての
en: He burned the LORD’s house, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem. He burned every great house with fire.
u.src: 9  He burned the LORD’s house, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem. He burned every great house with fire.

p.src: 10  All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down the walls around Jerusalem.

ja: とともにいたカルデア
en: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down the walls around Jerusalem.
u.src: 10  All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down the walls around Jerusalem.

p.src: 11  Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive the rest of the people who were left in the city and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon—all the rest of the multitude.

en: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive the rest of the people who were left in the city and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon—all the rest of the multitude.

ja: は、ぶどう畑と畑で働かせるために、その
en: But the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to work the vineyards and fields.
u.src: 12  But the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to work the vineyards and fields.

p.src: 13  The Chaldeans broke up the pillars of bronze that were in the LORD’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in the LORD’s house, and carried the bronze pieces to Babylon.

en: The Chaldeans broke up the pillars of bronze that were in the LORD’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in the LORD’s house, and carried the bronze pieces to Babylon.
u.src: 13  The Chaldeans broke up the pillars of bronze that were in the LORD’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in the LORD’s house, and carried the bronze pieces to Babylon.

ja: りばさみ、さじ、および彼らが
en: They took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.

p.src: 15  The captain of the guard took away the fire pans, the basins, that which was of gold, for gold, and that which was of silver, for silver.

en: The captain of the guard took away the fire pans, the basins, that which was of gold, for gold, and that which was of silver, for silver.
u.src: 15  The captain of the guard took away the fire pans, the basins, that which was of gold, for gold, and that which was of silver, for silver.

p.src: 16  The two pillars, the one sea, and the bases, which Solomon had made for the LORD’s house, the bronze of all these vessels was not weighed.

ja: については、これらすべての
en: The two pillars, the one sea, and the bases, which Solomon had made for the LORD’s house, the bronze of all these vessels was not weighed.
u.src: 16  The two pillars, the one sea, and the bases, which Solomon had made for the LORD’s house, the bronze of all these vessels was not weighed.

p.src: 17  The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and a capital of bronze was on it. The height of the capital was three cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital around it, all of bronze; and the second pillar with its network was like these.

ja: キュビト であり、その
もその網とともにこれと
en: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and a capital of bronze was on it. The height of the capital was three cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital around it, all of bronze; and the second pillar with its network was like these.
u.src: 17  The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and a capital of bronze was on it. The height of the capital was three cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital around it, all of bronze; and the second pillar with its network was like these.

ja: 25:17 一キュビトは成人男性の中指の先から肘までの長さで、約46センチメートル、または18インチである。
en: 25:17 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.

p.src: 18  The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold;

ja: の長セラヤと、第二位の
en: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold;

p.src: 19  and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and five men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe, the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the city.

en: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and five men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe, the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the city.

ja: ネブザルアダンは彼らを
らえ、リブラにいるバビロンの

en: The king of Babylon attacked them and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.

u.src: 22  As for the people who were left in the land of Judah whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, governor.
